data.name: Jumail
data.gender_notes: Jumail is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gathers or collects wealth, assets or resources. The name Jumail carries the meaning “Gatherer, Rich” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Jumail usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Allah meaning the One who gathers all things in His Mercy.
data.etymology: Jumail belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gatherer, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumail total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جميل
in_arabic.meaning: جميل يعني الجمال واللطف في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جميل مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-م-ل، ويعني الجمال والكمال، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا سلاما' (الإسراء: 53)، وقد استخدم في التاريخ الإسلامي كاسم للعديد من الشخصيات، مثل جميل بن عبد الله بن مالك

in_urdu.name: جمیل
in_urdu.meaning: جمیل نام کا مطلب خوبصورتی اور نیکی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمیل نام عربی زبان کی جڑ ج-م-ل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، کمال اور شان۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ خوب استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں، جہاں یہ اسلامی ثقافت کا ایک اہم حصہ ہے

in_hindi.name: जुमैल
in_hindi.meaning: जुमैल नाम का अर्थ सौंदर्य और अच्छाई है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुमैल नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ ज-م-ल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सौंदर्य, पूर्णता और महिमा। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में व्यापक रूप से प्रयोग किया जाता है, जहां यह इस्लामी संस्कृति का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है

in_pashto.name: جميل
in_pashto.meaning: جميل د ښکلا او نیکۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: جميل نوم د عربي کلمو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې ښکلا، کمال او عظمت دی. دا نوم د پښتنو په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د مسلمانانو لخوا کارول کېږي، او د هغوی په کلتور کې مهم ځای لري

in_english.name: Jumail
in_english.meaning: Jumail means beauty, kindness, and perfection in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jumail originates from the Arabic root ج-م-ل (J-M-L), which conveys meanings of beauty, perfection, and kindness. It is mentioned in several Quranic verses, emphasizing moral and spiritual beauty. Historically, the name has been used by various Islamic personalities, symbolizing good character and elegance. The name is widely used across Muslim cultures, signifying a person of noble attributes and compassion

data.cultural_impact: The name Jumail, which is believed to have originated from the Arabic language, carries a significant cultural impact in Islamic communities. As surnames or personal names, the name Jumail conveys prosperity, wealth, and abundance. In many Muslim countries, the accumulation and management of wealth are highly valued, and this name serves as a reminder of the importance of financial responsibility, economic stability, and social status.
data.spiritual_significance: Jumail also holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. While the name primarily represents wealth and material possessions, it serves as a reminder of the importance of using these blessings for the betterment of oneself and the wider community. In the Hadith, Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) stated that "It is meant for him who amasses property, and his heart is contented therewith, and he is self-sufficient from it and is not proud" (Bukhari). Thus, Jumail signifies a balance between material and spiritual wealth and the necessary goal of using one's blessings to fulfill religious obligations and contribute positively to society.
